title: Quick Shredded Argentinian Beef Empanadas
description: Enjoy a flavorful and earthy post-workout meal with these gluten-free-friendly empanadas featuring sun-dried tomatoes and yuzu-cure.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, yuzu-cured salt, sun-dried tomatoes, chopped onions, and chopped cilantro.
In a separate bowl, mix together the gluten-free all-purpose flour and cold unsalted butter until crumbly.
Add the egg and water to the flour mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk using a rolling pin.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture onto the center of each disk.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-circle and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
